evidence_level_definitions.LEVEL_0_NOT_TESTED: Code not executed in test environment.
evidence_level_definitions.LEVEL_1_IMPLEMENTED: Feature/module code written and syntactically valid.
evidence_level_definitions.LEVEL_2_UNIT_VERIFIED: Isolated unit tests passing in mock/in-memory environment.
evidence_level_definitions.LEVEL_3_INTEGRATION_VERIFIED: Local database / CLI end-to-end integration tests passing.
evidence_level_definitions.LEVEL_4_STAGING_ATTESTED: Verified against fixed Staging snapshot / SCN with rollback rehearsal.
evidence_level_definitions.LEVEL_5_PRODUCTION_ATTESTED: Verified against Production snapshot with immutable full-digest bundle.

claims.statement: 33 Sabermetrics metrics declared with formula version, inputs, outputs, LaTeX, and validation rules.

Dual Python implementation sample agreement on 33 metrics across 1,000 sampled rows / 967 distinct natural entity keys (16,500 evaluations): 16,311 defined (16,277 raw exact + 34 rounded contract), 189 undefined, 0 divergent.
Independent SQL reference queries (src/formulas/reference_sql/ and src/formulas/sql_reference.py) executing against SQLite / ANSI SQL.
Exhaustive census audit across all 11,938+ player seasons 1982-2026.
Staging Oracle Database SCN verified parity on sabermetric columns.
3,623,449 entities traced from source to DB row in local SQLite corpus.

R2 Natural Key Rekey 19-invariant safety suite (CAS, atomicity, idempotency, immutable receipts, replay verification, collision rejection, DSN guard) attested with 40 tests in ephemeral disposable DB.

deviations.description: Gate 2 execution was initiated prior to explicit user entry approval.
deviations.remediation: Classified as sample audit rather than full census, added dataset manifest, queries, selected-entities.jsonl, and independent SQL cross-validation.
